name.en: Mahalakshmi (free bus travel for women in Telangana)

summary.en: Free travel on TGSRTC Palle Velugu, Express, City Ordinary and Metro Express buses within Telangana, and up to the state border on interstate services

benefit.value_note: Your saving depends on how often you travel

name.en: A valid ID such as Aadhaar, driving licence or voter ID, to show to the conductor

en: There is no application. Board an eligible TGSRTC bus.
Show your ID to the conductor and take your zero-fare ticket.

to_confirm: You must be a resident (domicile) of Telangana
Bus category names and the list of covered services have changed since 2023; check with TGSRTC
Other benefits announced under the Mahalakshmi guarantee are not covered here yet
